task_name: Resolve Full Material Storage by Expanding Shop Queue and Accepting Advisor Trade Offer

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When tapping finished factory materials triggers 'Material Storage is full! (30/30)' and you cannot collect finished Nails or Wood needed for upgrades.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: When storage hits 30/30 with excess Metal (30 Metal), production halts. Unlocking an extra slot in the Building Supplies Store and accepting a Sim Advisor offer to sell 14 Metal for 79 Simoleons immediately frees 14 storage slots so Wood and Nails can be collected.
preconditions: Simoleon trade offer bubble visible on a city building
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Sell the overstocked raw material (Metal) via the yellow coin speech bubble.

steps.briefing: unlock a third production slot in the Building Supplies Store.

steps.who: yellow Simoleon offer bubble above the northern Small Factory
steps.briefing: open the neighbor mayor's purchase offer (28/14 Metal for 79 Simoleons).
sell 14 Metal to earn 79 Simoleons and free up 14 storage spaces.
